landing.heading: Spotted a bug in the wild?
landing.subtitle: Send a report, suggest a feature, or share an idea. No stack trace required.

category.label: What kind of feedback is this?

form.bugSubtitle: Tell us what happened and what you expected instead.
form.featureSubtitle: Add it to the backlog before it escapes your brain.
form.generalSubtitle: Good, bad, or somewhere in the call stack — we're listening.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What happened? What did you expect?
form.screenshotHelper: Screenshots can be worth a thousand log lines. Check that yours contains nothing sensitive — it's sent exactly as you selected it.
form.diagnosticsHelper: Adds sanitized technical metadata only — no prompts, terminal output, or session content.

diagnostics.heading: Debugging sidekick
diagnostics.subtitle: Review the sanitized technical details that can help us investigate.
diagnostics.previewIntro: This report may include the app version, build number, platform, OS version, update channel, connection status category, and configured-server count. It will not include prompts, terminal output, source code, credentials, server addresses, or session content.

validation.descriptionRequired: Give us a few details so we have something to debug.
validation.descriptionTooShort: A few more characters will help us debug the plot.
validation.emailInvalid: That email doesn't look quite right. Leave it blank if you'd rather stay anonymous.

success.title: Feedback committed
success.message: Thanks — your report made it into the queue with no merge conflicts.

error.title: Push failed
error.message: We couldn't send your report. Your feedback is still here, so you can try again.

offline.title: Looks like the network branch is offline
offline.message: Reconnect and try again, or copy the report for later.

screenshotError.title: That screenshot won't fit
screenshotError.message: Please pick a smaller image and try again.

copyFallback.title: Let's finish this by hand
copyFallback.step1: Tap the copy icon to copy your report.
copyFallback.step3: Paste it there and hit send.
